# bioexcel/biobb_haddock/haddock3_passive_from_active

## Summary

Wrapper class for the Haddock3-Restraints passive_from_active module.

Haddock3-Restraints passive_from_active given a list of active_residues and a PDB structure, it will return a list of surface exposed passive residues within a radius (6.5Å by default) from the active residues.

Nextflow adapter of the [PassiveFromActive](https://biobb-haddock.readthedocs.io/en/latest/haddock_restraints.html#module-haddock_restraints.haddock3_passive_from_active) building block of [biobb_haddock](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_haddock) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_HADDOCK_HADDOCK3_PASSIVE_FROM_ACTIVE } from 'bioexcel/biobb_haddock/haddock3_passive_from_active'

workflow {
    BIOBB_HADDOCK_HADDOCK3_PASSIVE_FROM_ACTIVE(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input PDB structure file |
| `input_active_list_path` | no | txt, dat, list | Path to the input file with list of active residues |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_actpass_path` | yes | txt, dat, list, out | Path to the output file with list of passive residues |
| `versions_biobb_haddock` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_haddock', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of PassiveFromActive properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_actpass_path: 'txt']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_haddock container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_HADDOCK_HADDOCK3_PASSIVE_FROM_ACTIVE' {
        ext.properties = [radius: 6.5]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active_list` | string | "" | List of active residues as a comma-separated string. Required if input_active_list_path is not provided. |
| `chain_id` | string | null | Chain ID to consider when calculating passive residues. |
| `surface_list_path` | string | "" | Path to file with list of surface residues to filter. |
| `radius` | number | 6.5 | Radius in Angstroms to look for surface residues around active ones. |
| `binary_path` | string | "haddock3-restraints" | Path to the haddock3-restraints executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
